text.KredimGeldi KVKK aydınlatma metni: kişis: KredimGeldi KVKK Privacy Information Notice: the purposes for which your personal data is processed and your rights.
text.6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması: Our Privacy Information Notice on how your personal data is processed under the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698.
text.Kişisel Verileriniz Nasıl İşlenir?: How Is Your Personal Data Processed?
text.360Dijital (\"Şirket\"), kişisel veriler: 360Dijital (the "Company") aims to ensure that personal data is processed in compliance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK") and the provisions of other relevant legislation.
text.Şirketimizin gerçek kişi müşterisi olman: As you are a natural-person customer of our Company, we hereby notify and inform you that your personal data, whether provided by you to our Company or obtained by our Company externally through any means, will, by our Company in its capacity as "Data Controller", be processed;
text.Kişisel verilerinizin işlenme amaçları d: In line with and in connection with the purposes for which your personal data is processed, in a limited and proportionate manner,
text.Tarafınızca bildirilen veya bildirildiği: While maintaining the accuracy and currency of your personal data as provided by you or in the form in which it was provided,
text.Kişisel verilerinizin kaydedileceğini, d: That your personal data will be recorded, stored, retained and, where necessary, reorganized,
text.Kanunen bu verileri talep etmeye yetkili: That it will be shared with institutions legally authorized to request such data,
text.KVKK'nın öngördüğü şartlar kapsamında, y: That, within the scope of the conditions stipulated by KVKK, it will be transferred or assigned to third parties in Türkiye or abroad, classified, and may be processed in the other ways specified in the Law.
We hereby notify and inform you accordingly.
text.Şirketimiz, işbu Aydınlatma Metni ile yü: Our Company undertakes, by means of this Privacy Information Notice, that all of its activities will be conducted and continuously improved in compliance with the fundamental principles set out in KVKK.
